int_name: ARAMINGO AVE & DELAWARE EXPY RAMP XY

result.summary: This is a high-speed, multi-lane intersection that completely lacks pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by large vehicles and wide asphalt expanses, making it extremely hostile for anyone on foot.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at this large, signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: No paved walkways are provided along the roadway, forcing pedestrians to walk on the shoulder or in traffic lanes.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a long distance without any refuge islands.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings at all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian countdown signals and push buttons to provide dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to reduce the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide arterial roadway with a separated multi-use path that lacks a safe connection across the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals visible, creating a hostile and inaccessible environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk
hazards.description: No marked crossing at a signalized intersection forces pedestrians to cross unmarked lanes on a wide roadway.

hazards.name: Inaccessible Path Terminus
hazards.description: The paved path ends at a vertical curb without a ramp, making it inaccessible for wheelchair users.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground where path meets the road

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No signals are present to indicate safe crossing intervals for pedestrians at the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps to provide a level transition between the path and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and push buttons.

result.summary: The image shows a paved multi-use path separated from a roadway by a grass buffer and a row of trees. There is a complete lack of crossing infrastructure, lighting, or traffic control devices visible in the immediate vicinity, and a large portion of the foreground roadway is obscured by a camera artifact.

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street lights are visible, which would make the path and roadway dangerous for pedestrians at night.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signals to facilitate safe crossing of the adjacent roadway.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting along the path and standard street lighting for the roadway to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs if this location serves as a crossing point.

result.summary: The image shows a high-speed, multi-lane arterial roadway that is highly hostile to pedestrians. There is a complete lack of crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or signals, despite the significant width of the road.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of high-speed traffic without any refuge or markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: High-speed vehicle environment
hazards.description: Wide lanes and open geometry encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of fatal collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes occupied by vehicles

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Signalization
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and a pedestrian-actuated signal or HAWK beacon.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce lane widths to naturally slow vehicle speeds and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.
